observations: Two target copy loops use a BIOS code starting offset of 0030h and an end value of 2da0h plus a runtime word at CS:0ff7h.
A preceding routine computes that word as (word at 01d5:2da6 + 001fh) AND fff0h.
Under the independently hypothesized code-image mapping with file base 1c50h, the candidate file word at 49f6h is 01a2h; this would produce an added length of 01c0h and a copied span of 2f30h.
The 01d5:06f5 error vector and resource length ending at IOSYSMSG independently corroborate the candidate image mapping; runtime mutation remains unverified.
limitations: The 01d5:2da6 runtime address has not been traced to its loaded contents independently of the candidate file mapping.
The dynamic copied span is not proven to be the BIOS_CODE segment length used by historical GETSIZE.
Using that span as BIOCODESIZ would conflict with the conditional legacy origin aggregate, so doing so would be unjustified without resolving target loading and layout.
No target source constants are changed.
